basis.universe: S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 constituents (FMP); a stock in both counts once.
basis.price: FMP quote: last price and % change from the previous official close.
basis.bars: Polygon 5-minute bars, regular session 09:30–16:00 ET, 15 minutes delayed.
basis.moneyFlow: Money Flow Index method: typical price (H+L+C)/3 × volume per 5-minute bar, inflow when the typical price rose from the prior bar, outflow when it fell. Net = inflow − outflow; sector = sum of its stocks.
basis.sectorPct: Equal-weighted average % move of the sector's stocks.
basis.breadth: S&P 500 constituents up / down / unchanged vs the previous close.
basis.rvol: Day volume ÷ (20-session average daily volume × share of the regular session elapsed).
basis.m30: Change over the last 30 minutes (six 5-minute bars), in % of the previous close.
basis.pivots: Classic pivots from the previous session's high/low (Polygon daily bar) and official close.
basis.zone: Most recent unmitigated order block on the side of the move (5-minute bars).
basis.levels: Entry = zone edge nearest price, stop = far edge, target = first pivot beyond entry and price; R:R = |target − entry| ÷ |entry − stop|.
basis.marketCap: Polygon weighted shares outstanding × price (as Stock Detail).
basis.sector: App sector (companies), else SIC-derived like Stock Detail.
